description: This file defines the AwsException class within the Aws\Exception namespace, representing an exception that occurs during AWS SDK command execution. It includes detailed information about errors, response, request, and associated data.

classes.name: AwsException
classes.description: Represents an AWS SDK exception for command failures, providing access to request, response, error details, and supporting retry and transfer info management.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a new AwsException instance with message, command, context info, and previous exception.

methods.name: __toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the exception, including nested exception details.

methods.name: getCommand
methods.description: Returns the command object that was executed when the exception was thrown.

methods.name: getAwsErrorMessage
methods.description: Returns the concise AWS error message, if available.

methods.name: getRequest
methods.description: Returns the HTTP request associated with the error, if available.

methods.name: getResponse
methods.description: Returns the HTTP response associated with the error, if available.

methods.name: getResult
methods.description: Returns the result object if available.

methods.name: isConnectionError
methods.description: Indicates whether the error was caused by a connection issue.

methods.name: getStatusCode
methods.description: Returns the HTTP status code of the response, if available.

methods.name: getAwsRequestId
methods.description: Returns the AWS request ID associated with the error.

methods.name: getAwsErrorType
methods.description: Returns the error type provided by AWS.

methods.name: getAwsErrorCode
methods.description: Returns the error code from AWS.

methods.name: getAwsErrorShape
methods.description: Returns the error shape information.

methods.name: getTransferInfo
methods.description: Returns transfer details or specific transfer statistic.

methods.name: setTransferInfo
methods.description: Sets the transfer information for the exception.

methods.name: isMaxRetriesExceeded
methods.description: Indicates whether the maximum retries limit has been reached.

methods.name: setMaxRetriesExceeded
methods.description: Sets the flag indicating retries have exceeded the maximum.

methods.name: hasKey
methods.description: Checks if a specific key exists in the data array.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a value by key from the exception.

methods.name: search
methods.description: Performs a JMESPath search on the exception's data.
